svg.text: Where the controller sits, and who owns which piece. Green = you build it into the SoC; blue = this IP; purple = vendor PHY and DRAM.
SoC fabric / NoC - you build this
boot orchestration - unified CSR - cross-stack RAS - DVFS - refresh phase
Total: 256 pseudo-channels - 8.19 TB/s raw - 240 GB usable with ECC on
